description: This file defines an abstract class 'Smarty_CacheResource' which outlines the interface and some common functionality for cache resource handlers within the Smarty templating engine. It includes method signatures for caching operations such as populate, process, read, write, and cache management, as well as lock handling and resource loading.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource
classes.description: Abstract class providing an interface and partial implementation for cache resource handlers in Smarty.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populate a cached object with metadata from the resource.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Populate a cached object with timestamp and existence info from the resource.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Read the cached template and process headers.

methods.name: writeCachedContent
methods.description: Write the rendered output to cache.

methods.name: getCachedContent
methods.description: Return the cached content if processing succeeds; otherwise, null.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear cache for a specific resource.

methods.name: locked
methods.description: Check if cache is locked, wait if necessary.

methods.name: hasLock
methods.description: Check if the cache for a template is locked.

methods.name: acquireLock
methods.description: Lock the cache for a template.

methods.name: releaseLock
methods.description: Release the lock on the cache for a template.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Load a cache resource handler by type.
